dedupe_keys.name: bim4eeb building sensor measurement datasets monza italy and chorzow poland

description: These two datasets hold indoor sensor measurements from residential buildings renovated in the BIM4EEB project, a Horizon 2020 project on a BIM-based fast toolkit for efficient renovation of buildings. They were published by the project consortium on Zenodo on 30 June 2022: one from demonstration flats in Monza, Italy, and one from Chorzów, Poland. Each dataset has one CSV file per monitored location, giving sensor code, sensor type, timestamp, value, unit and measure type; the readme describes each location by flat, floor, orientation and number of rooms, and the Polish set includes a local weather station. The Italian set covers about a dozen locations, the Polish set six. Access: open download from Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0; free for non-commercial use. Caveats: a small sample of flats, and the no-derivatives term restricts publishing modified versions. Simulation uses are calibrating and validating building energy and comfort models before and after renovation, and testing digital twin data pipelines. Related records: the GECAD smart building datasets and the crossCert EPC benchmark buildings.
